overloadMerges.note: R5's two syntax lines use the established optional-leading-star object-name/reference discriminator.

params.name: padding
params.description: Object with optional Integer top, bottom, left and right padding values in pixels.

discriminatedBy.rule: With *, object is a name string; without *, pass a variable or field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets padding for the designated form object(s), leaving omitted padding properties unchanged.

constraints: Introduced in 21 R5 BETA; supports text areas, inputs, list boxes, columns, headers and footers.
Negative padding values have an effective value of zero.
For list boxes, columns, headers and footers, only top and left affect rendering: top supplies both vertical sides and left supplies both horizontal sides.
